title: Send a submission's failed parses again

v1.description: Sends again the uploads whose parse failed, and any never sent; ones already queued or parsed are left alone. A failure is usually the daemon being down, not the document, so trying again is often all the submitter needs. The submitter fires it with POST <submission>.retryParse.json, offered in the view next to the error message. It does not check whether a retry can work: a broken document or a daemon still down just fails again, and the submitter sees that.

parse.label: Send the uploads that failed again
